name: aws_quicksight_group
description: Creates an Amazon QuickSight group for organizing users and managing access to dashboards and datasets in your BI environment.

aws_account_id.name: aws_account_id
aws_account_id.description: The ID for the AWS account that the group is in. Defaults to the ID of the AWS account.

namespace.name: namespace
namespace.description: The namespace that you want the group to be a part of.
